decisions.reason: It has remained prominently listed since its 2023 launch and fits the firm's established equipment portfolio, so the option value of staying in the market is still high while incremental continuation risk appears low.

As a 2024 launch outside the firm's core dental and hearing businesses, it likely requires distinct market access and support effort, so with limited evidence of fit the firm would rationally redeploy resources to stronger core options.

Although still early and only lightly presented in 2024, it is close to the firm's digital manufacturing trajectory and core customer workflows, so management would likely keep it on the market to learn more before making a final commitment.
